rules.description: Disallow eval() and dynamic code execution.
rules.message: Use of eval() is forbidden in generated code.

rules.description: Disallow new Function() for dynamic code execution.
rules.message: Use of new Function() is forbidden in generated code.
Shell execution APIs are forbidden in generated code.

rules.description: Disallow hardcoded secrets or tokens in code.
rules.message: Hardcoded secrets are forbidden. Use environment variables.
Insecure hash algorithm detected. Use SHA-256 or stronger.
Math.random is not cryptographically secure. Use crypto.randomBytes().

rules.description: Discourage logging of tokens or passwords.
rules.message: Avoid logging sensitive values such as tokens or passwords.
Avoid SQL string concatenation. Use parameterized queries.

rules.description: Disallow console logging in generated code.
rules.message: Console logging is forbidden in generated code. Use a structured logger.

rules.description: Disallow inline Express app creation in generated microservice modules.
rules.message: Generated modules must export a router or class module, not create an Express app instance inline.

rules.description: Disallow treating environment variables as database clients.
rules.message: Do not call .query() on a process.env value. Use a real pg Pool/client configured from environment variables.

rules.description: Disallow logging sensitive token/password data with structured loggers.
rules.message: Do not log tokens, passwords, or secrets; sanitize or remove sensitive values from logs.
